compiled_state.title: [ticket-tracker]: DSO workflow systemically creates orphan tickets -> ~104 hash-id orphans accumulated, 1/5 health score
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Problem
The DSO ticket-creation workflow produces orphan tickets (no parent_id) at scale. The 2026-05-12 audit found ~104 hash-id orphan tasks/stories/bugs in addition to all 71 jira-dig-* mirrors. validate-issues.sh reports health score 1/5 (Critical), 106 warnings dominated by 'orphan ticket: no epic parent'.

This bug captures the systemic workflow failure separately from the bridge-side bug (`36cf-48d7` — inbound drops parent_id) and the skill-specific bug (`8905-5697` — /dso:respond-to-pr-comments stubs).

## Hypothesized origins (need investigation)
1. `ticket create` is called without `--parent` in skill scripts where a parent epic/story is in scope but not threaded through.
2. Sub-agents creating tickets (bug discovery, follow-up tasks during sprint, retro tickets) don't always receive the current epic/story ID from the orchestrator.
3. PR-comment / fix-bug flows that spawn follow-up tasks lose the originating epic linkage.
4. `ticket link` calls may be silently failing after creation (no error surfacing into the orchestrator).
5. No CI / pre-commit check that warns when a non-epic ticket is created without a parent.

## Evidence (sampled from audit)
- Bucket (a) — 3 task-typed tickets that should be tasks under known epics but were created parent-less: 6857-4c50 (brainstorm SKILL.md update), 6867-f7ff (runner.py refactor for story DD3 — explicit Story ID in description but no parent_id), 7640-f95b (fault-injection test, references Story 0263-62ba in description).
- Bucket (b) — ~31 orphan tasks clustering under epics af26-dd5a, ed62-08cd, 6068-cb2d, 4100-95a4 by title/topic; descriptions sometimes reference the parent story explicitly.
- Bucket (b1) — 8 'PR comment deferred:' stubs from /dso:respond-to-pr-comments (now deleted; tracked under 8905-5697).
- 34 standalone bugs are excluded — bugs are legitimately parent-less.

## Investigation entry points
- Grep skill files for `ticket create` calls that don't pass `--parent`: `grep -rn 'ticket create' plugins/dso/skills/` and audit each call site.
- Check whether sub-agent prompts include the current parent ID in their context payload.
- Audit `ticket link` failure paths — should be fatal at the orchestrator, not silently swallowed.
- Consider adding a pre-event validator: refuse `ticket create story|task` without `--parent` unless `--standalone` flag is set.

## Expected behavior
Every story and task ticket created by a DSO skill should have a parent_id at creation time. Orphan stories/tasks should require explicit opt-in (a `--standalone` flag or post-hoc human decision), not be the default.

## Acceptance signal
After fix: in a 1-week observation window, no new hash-id story/task tickets land in the tracker with parent_id=null. validate-issues.sh orphan count trends down (not just from cleanup work but from no new orphans being added).

comments.body: Investigation result: Fix complexity COMPLEX. The bug spans multiple subsystems (skill files, sub-agent prompts, ticket-create CLI, potential pre-event hook) with at least 4 distinct root causes (missing --parent in skill call sites, sub-agent context payloads lacking parent ID, silently-swallowed ticket link failures, no creation-time validator). Per fix-bug Phase D Step 2, single-track fix is inappropriate — this requires /dso:brainstorm for epic-level scoping and design decisions (e.g., make --parent mandatory for story/task ticket types? add --standalone opt-out? add pre-event validator hook?). Leaving open. Recommend invoking /dso:brainstorm 7883-a502-e318-403e in a separate session to scope an epic.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Fix complexity: COMPLEX confirmed in 2026-05-16 session — escalating to /dso:brainstorm. Policy decisions out of fix-bug scope: warn vs hard-fail at creation, --standalone opt-out semantics, retro cleanup of existing ~104 orphans, ticket link failure surfacing.
